## berth tool set

pin a tool to one exact version, installed at the org's next start

### Synopsis

pin a tool to one exact version, installed at the org's next start

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_tool_set/

```
berth tool set <org> <name> <source> <version> [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth tool set acme gadget github:acme/gadget 1.4.2
  berth restart acme   # to install it
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help[=true|false]   help for set
```
